name: Devi Phommachanh
description:
Devi Phommachanh was a military tracker for Sterling-Nakamura's urban warfare division before going freelance. In the military she tracked deserters, infiltrators, and enemy combatants through the most hostile urban environments on the planet. In civilian life she tracks fugitives, missing persons, and anyone who doesn't want to be found — and she finds them, because in twenty years of tracking she has never lost a quarry.

Her method is relentlessly physical. She operates below the digital layer entirely, reading the city the way a forest tracker reads the woods — broken stems become scuff marks, animal tracks become footprints, disturbed earth becomes moved debris. She can determine how long ago someone passed through a corridor by the rate at which dust has resettled. She can estimate a target's physical condition by the depth and spacing of their footprints. She can predict where someone will go based on the urban terrain the way a hunter predicts where an animal will drink.

She is a blunt instrument in a world that increasingly values digital sophistication, and she doesn't care. Her clients hire her when the target has gone analog — when they've ditched their BCI, abandoned their digital identity, and disappeared into the physical city. Other investigators stop at that point. Aroha starts. She will follow a target until one of them collapses, and it's never her.
affiliation: Independent — operates on retainer for three Tier 2-3 firms who need fieldwork done
location: A spartan apartment above a gym in Steamvent Alley — nothing on the walls, nothing personal, packed bag always by the door, near North Ave and Milwaukee
specialization: Physical tracking and fugitive recovery in urban environments
methods: Urban tracking — reading footprints, disturbances, and physical evidence of passage through city environments
Endurance pursuit — following a target on foot for days at a pace they can't sustain
Behavioral prediction based on military psychology profiling
Using the city's infrastructure against targets — knowing which routes funnel into dead ends
Setting physical surveillance traps — tripwires, motion sensors, pressure plates
notable_cases: Tracked a corporate defector across seven districts over nine days, following physical signs of passage through areas with no electronic surveillance
Recovered a kidnap victim by literally following the tire marks of the vehicle from the abduction site through seventeen kilometers of Shelf streets
Found a serial arsonist by identifying the pattern of their scouting routes — they always walked the target site three times before striking
equipment: Military-grade boots with terrain analysis sensors — reads surface composition and recent disturbances
Miniaturized drone with thermal imaging for aerial tracking
Physical restraints — she always brings the target back, alive if possible
Nutritional implant that allows extended operations without food stops
Weatherproof field kit — she's tracked targets through three-day storms without shelter
personality: Aroha is Maori-Russian-Ghanaian, forty years old, stocky and powerful with dark skin, close-cropped black hair, and a face that has been broken and reset enough times to have its own topography. She doesn't talk much because talking wastes energy and energy is a finite resource during pursuit. She thinks in distances, timelines, and probabilities. She can read a person's weight, gait, speed, and emotional state from their footprints, and she considers this skill more reliable than any BCI scan. She has no social life because every hour not spent tracking is an hour spent preparing to track. She is not unfriendly — she is simply monomaniacally focused on a single skill, and everything else in her life has atrophied.

relationships.name: Sergeant Major Dato Engstrom-Fofana
relationships.description: Still active in Sterling-Nakamura's military — occasionally passes Aroha intelligence when their interests align

relationships.name: Amara Lindqvist-Diallo
relationships.description: Amara has hired Aroha twice for tracking in child recovery cases — they respect each other's abilities but disagree on methods

story_hooks: Aroha is hired to track someone who is clearly a better tracker than she is — for the first time in her career, she's following someone who knows exactly how to avoid being followed by someone with her skills
A target she's pursuing leads her into the Underbelly, where her surface-tracking skills are useless — she needs help from someone who knows the tunnels
Sterling-Nakamura contacts her with a contract that's technically legal but morally unconscionable — track a group of refugees who are fleeing corporate territory

physical_description.heritage: Southeast Asian dominant (39.9%) blended with South Asian (18.3%), Sub-Saharan African (12.4%), Northern European (12.1%), Indigenous American (8.8%), and Hispanic/Latin American (8.5%) ancestry. This creates a striking, globally-mixed phenotype with warm medium-brown skin displaying golden, reddish, and subtle olive undertones from the Southeast Asian-South Asian-African foundation. Angular cheekbones and eye shape reflect Southeast Asian prominence, while broader facial structure and deeper warm tones incorporate South Asian and Sub-Saharan African genetics. The blending creates refined definition with warmth—Northern European ancestry contributes subtle cooler undertones and lighter notes that prevent harshness, while Indigenous American and Hispanic/Latin American ancestry adds depth to the overall warm palette.
physical_description.build: Athletic and lean, muscled without bulk — a tracker's build. Shoulders broad but not overdeveloped; legs thick and capable. Twenty years of sustained physical work have carved away anything unnecessary.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with natural reddish undertones
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back tight in a single braid, utilitarian
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown, alert and constantly moving
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium brown with golden, reddish, and subtle olive undertones, reflecting the Southeast Asian-South Asian foundation enriched by Sub-Saharan African depth and refined by cooler Northern European notes
physical_description.complexion: Weathered and unadorned. Minimal cosmetic concern; skin shows exposure to elements. Facial structure shows Southeast Asian angular cheekbones and South Asian eye shape, grounded in warm Sub-Saharan African undertones with refined definition enhanced by the genetic blending. No tattoos or body modification — she leaves no marks. Hands are calloused from years of climbing, gripping, pushing through urban terrain.
distinguishing_marks: Scar along the left temple, thin and old, running from hairline to cheekbone — shrapnel wound from a Sterling-Nakamura operation in the Midwest Reclamation Zone
Burn mark on the right forearm, small circular scar — old accident with thermal equipment, barely noticeable unless you look
Multiple small white scars across both palms and knuckles — years of climbing, crawling, fighting through hostile terrain
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None visible. She operates deliberately below the digital layer and has rejected neural integration. No chrome, no LED optics, no subdermal plating.
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical and alert. She moves like someone scanning terrain constantly — head up, eyes tracking peripheral movement, weight balanced on the balls of her feet. No wasted motion. When stationary, she stands with hands free and visible, back to wall when possible. Her gaze settles on details others miss — scuff marks, dust patterns, the way a door frame is worn.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 practical. Dark utilitarian gear: fitted cargo pants with reinforced pockets and knee pads, thermal-lined jacket over a plain black compression shirt, worn tactical boots with deep tread. No logos, no branding, nothing that catches light or draws attention. Everything chosen for function — pockets for tools, materials for climbing and moving through hostile environments, colors that blend into urban concrete and shadow. A small backpack, always worn, containing climbing gear, dust masks, thermal imaging tools, and a packed bag always at home ready for immediate deployment. She dresses like someone who might need to move fast, climb anything, or disappear into a warehouse at a moment's notice.
